verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing says it offers APIs that connect the virtual mailbox to other tools and keep documents and mail in sync, so an API capability exists. However, no API reference, endpoints, authentication details or developer docs appear in the evidence. missing for 10: documented public API reference, a list-mail-items endpoint, scan/PDF download endpoint, authentication and developer onboarding docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list mail items and download scans through a documented public API — my systems ingest postal mail like any other data source

citations.quote: API integrations to connect your mailbox with the tools you already use
Use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use, so your documents and mail stay in sync and your work keeps moving.
